command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
$branch="work/shell-provider-copyout-20261007"
$candidate="05c4f488ed9122b25f0956840967fbde4c2ebc9e"
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
& git fetch origin $branch --no-tags --prune
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "provider copyout AppsFolder diagnostic fetch failed"}
if((& git rev-parse ("refs/remotes/origin/"+$branch)).Trim() -ne $candidate){throw "provider copyout diagnostic candidate mismatch"}
$exe=Join-Path $repo "out\winui\Release\flyExplorer.exe"
if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe -PathType Leaf)){throw "provider copyout Release binary missing"}
$script=Join-Path $repo "logs\provider-copyout-appsfolder-diagnosis.py"
@'
import ctypes as c, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
from pywinauto import Desktop
from pywinauto.keyboard import send_keys
from tests.winui.uia_polling import wait_until

repo=Path(os.environ["FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT"])
exe=repo/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
owned=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="provider-copyout-apps-diag-",dir=repo/"logs"))
dest=owned/"destination";dest.mkdir()
env=os.environ.copy()
for key in ("APPDATA","LOCALAPPDATA","TEMP","TMP"):
    p=owned/key.lower();p.mkdir();env[key]=str(p)
pref=Path(env["LOCALAPPDATA"])/"flyExplorer";pref.mkdir(parents=True)
(pref/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_bytes(
 b"schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=details\r\n")
proc=None;parent=None
try:
    proc=subprocess.Popen([str(exe),str(dest)],cwd=exe.parent,env=env,
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    def ready():
        global parent
        if proc.poll() is not None:return False
        wins=[w for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=proc.pid)
              if "flyExplorer" in w.window_text()]
        if len(wins)!=1:return False
        parent=Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=wins[0].handle)
        return parent.child_window(auto_id="LeftFiles").exists(timeout=.2)
    wait_until(ready,"AppsFolder diagnostic window",seconds=24,interval=.25)
    address=parent.child_window(auto_id="AddressBox")
    left=parent.child_window(auto_id="LeftFiles")
    right=parent.child_window(auto_id="RightFiles")
    status=parent.child_window(auto_id="StatusText")
    parent.set_focus();send_keys("{F6}");time.sleep(.2)
    address.set_edit_text(str(dest));address.type_keys("{ENTER}",set_foreground=True)
    wait_until(lambda:str(dest).lower() in address.get_value().lower(),
               "destination navigation",seconds=18,interval=.25)
    parent.set_focus();send_keys("{F6}");time.sleep(.2)
    address.set_edit_text("shell:AppsFolder");address.type_keys("{ENTER}",set_foreground=True)
    wait_until(lambda:"AppsFolder" in address.get_value() or len([
        x for x in left.descendants() if x.element_info.control_type=="ListItem"])>0,
        "AppsFolder navigation",seconds=24,interval=.25)
    rows=[x for x in left.descendants()
          if x.element_info.control_type=="ListItem"]
    print("PROVIDER_COPYOUT_APPS_ADDRESS",repr(address.get_value()),flush=True)
    print("PROVIDER_COPYOUT_APPS_ROWS",repr([x.window_text() for x in rows[:12]]),flush=True)
    if not rows:raise AssertionError("AppsFolder is empty")
    item=next((x for x in rows if x.window_text().startswith("[파일]")),rows[0])
    item.select()
    parent.child_window(auto_id="MoveButton").invoke()
    wait_until(lambda:"복사만 지원" in status.window_text(),
               "AppsFolder provider Move rejection",seconds=8,interval=.25)
    print("PROVIDER_COPYOUT_APPS_MOVE_REJECT",True,flush=True)
    parent.child_window(auto_id="CopyButton").invoke()
    time.sleep(8)
    print("PROVIDER_COPYOUT_APPS_STATUS",repr(status.window_text()),flush=True)
    print("PROVIDER_COPYOUT_APPS_DEST",repr([p.name for p in dest.iterdir()]),flush=True)
finally:
    if proc and proc.poll() is None:
        try:
            c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(parent.handle if parent else 0,0x10,0,0)
            proc.wait(timeout=10)
        except Exception:
            proc.terminate();proc.wait(timeout=5)
    shutil.rmtree(owned,ignore_errors=True)
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding UTF8
try {
  $env:PYTHONPATH=$repo
  & python -X utf8 $script
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "provider copyout AppsFolder diagnostic failed"}
} finally {
  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
Write-Host "SHELL_PROVIDER_COPYOUT_APPSFOLDER_DIAGNOSIS=PASS"
